Package it.uninsubria.laboratorioa.objects.enums

Enum Class Nation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Nation>
it.uninsubria.laboratorioa.objects.enums.Nation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Nation>, Constable
public enum Nation extends Enum<Nation>
Enum representing the nations supported by the system. Each nation is associated with an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

Author: Luca Cavagnari Version: 1.0
